patch_description: This version combines a broad stochastic contact-search phase with an explicit diameter-packing feasibility solve and a final exact-ratio contact-exchange polish. The initial phase uses continuation on a smooth log-distance contrast to discover several distinct contact graphs. The strongest configurations are then rescaled so their shortest distance is one and polished by directly minimizing the squared diameter under all pairwise lower- and upper-distance constraints. Finally, a small deterministic/random tangent perturbation stage accepts only strict improvements in the evaluator’s actual squared ratio, allowing small contact graph adjustments that smooth objectives and constrained solvers can miss.
